about: Normalised text (OR-14 items 1 and 2, ADR 0011): walked job ids become placeholders, and user text that looks like a placeholder or marker is escaped so that the normalised string stays injective. The escape is milestone E2's choice, which ADR 0011 left open: a maximal run of '<' that is followed by a placeholder, a marker, or text beginning job:, stack>, loc> or masked> is doubled; every other '<' is kept. In raw texts, ${name} stands for the id of the walked job named in ids. Provenance is policy: the escape is windmill-lite's own choice.

encode.name: text without a marker head is unchanged
a walked id becomes its placeholder
a > in a module id is %3E inside the placeholder
user text that looks like a placeholder is escaped
a user < before a walked id is escaped
text before a < and a walked id
a run of < before job: is doubled
user text that looks like the stack marker is escaped
user text that looks like the location marker is escaped
user text that looks like the mask marker is escaped
a near miss of a marker is unchanged

distinct.name: the drafted <<job: rule's collision: a user < before a walked id, against user text that looks like that id's placeholder
a walked id against user text that looks like its placeholder
the id of module a>b against the id of a followed by b>
a walked id against an unknown UUID
two < before a walked id against one < before user placeholder text
